Current senior pastor John Wilkerson (since 2013) inherited the institution at its lowest reputational point and has publicly acknowledged the failures while leading reform. The congregation is included for completeness as one of the most consequential IFB institutions in the country, but is rated YELLOW with significant caution: the documented abuse history, Hyles-era pastor-as-king theology, and KJV-Only doctrinal emphasis all warrant discernment. Adam should not visit casually; survivors of Hyles/Schaap-era abuse remain a live pastoral concern within IFB circles.
